description: This file defines a class StrikethroughHandler that manages the application of strikethrough spans in a Markdown editor, specifically handling the "~~" delimiter for strikethrough syntax within the Markdown parsing process.

classes.name: StrikethroughHandler
classes.description: A handler class that integrates with a Markdown editor to support strikethrough formatting triggered by "~~" delimiters.

methods.name: configurePersistedSpans
methods.description: Configures the spans that should be persisted for strikethrough formatting, associating the span type with the span class.

methods.name: handleMarkdownSpan
methods.description: Handles the application of the strikethrough span to the editable text when the markdown syntax is detected.

methods.name: markdownSpanType
methods.description: Returns the class type of the span used for strikethrough formatting.
